post.text:
It’s #MedSafetyWeek (3–9 Nov)! Medicines are helpful in treating illnesses, but can sometimes cause side effects. Use them as directed and report problems to Medsafe. Let’s make medicines safer together.

#MedSafetyWeek2025 #MSW #MedSafe #MinistryofHealthNZ
